2014_spells.maximilian-s-earthen-grasp.e: Deal 2d6 bludgeoning damage to a target within 30 ft
2014_spells.maximilian-s-earthen-grasp.f: Using 1 action, you choose a 5-foot-square unoccupied space on ground that you can see within range. On a failed save, the target takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained for the duration; The target takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a success, the target escapes and the spell ends; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
